sections.title: Svc::FprimeFramer
sections.text_preview:
The `Svc::FprimeFramer` is an implementation of the [FramerInterface](../../Interfaces/docs/sdd.md) for the F Prime protocol. 

It receives data (an F´ packet) on input and produces an [F´ frame](../.

sections.title: Usage Examples
sections.text_preview: The `Svc::FprimeFramer` component is used in the uplink stack of many reference F´ application such as [the tutorials source code](https://github.com/fprime-community#tutorials).

sections.title: Internals
sections.text_preview: The `Svc::FprimeFramer` receives data packets of type `Svc.ComDataWithContext`. This type contains both a `Fw::Buffer` containing the packet data, and a `context: FrameContext` that contains contextua
